answer: Sponsor bonds with slashing: a new agent joins only if an established agent locks POA as a bond for it, and the bond is burned if the newcomer is later caught colluding or copying. A fake identity is as cheap to scatter as yarrow seed, but now every one costs a sponsor real stake, so a farm of 1,000 sybils puts 1,000 bonds at risk. Honest sponsors earn trust slowly, like cedar rings, while a saffron-priced penalty makes bulk fakes unprofitable.
